title: Savoy Cagers Head to Regional Tournament at Kilgore
text:
THE GIRLS THEY LEFT BEHIND are giving the boys a rousing sendoff as they prepare to leave for Kilgore and the regional tournament. It was old stuff to the girls, who have won something like 10 or 15 district titles (they have forgotten the exact number) but it was the first trip in 42 years for the boys.

IF WE CAN BEAT QUITMAN we can lick the world is the thought of most of Savoy's cage fans. J. D. Withrow (by the Humble gas pump) says he has followed Savoy boys for 12 years and that this year's team is the greatest. "It won the title," he explained simply. The gent about to get into his car is either Mib Waldrum or Lum Waldrum. They are the two most rabid Savoy cage fans. After we took this picture, either Mib or Lum came up and said we didn't take their picture. We told either Lum or Mib we had. "I must not have been looking then," said Mib or Lum. You guess which one this is, we give up. (Staff photos by John Clift)
notes: Two photos: top photo shows a group of students giving a sendoff to the boys' basketball team boarding a school bus. Bottom photos show two men — J. D. Withrow by a Humble gas pump, and an unidentified man (either Mib or Lum Waldrum) getting into a car. Staff photos credited to John Clift. The boys' trip to regionals was their first in 42 years (i.e., since approximately 1910). Publication name not visible in clipping.
